There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The weekend breakfast has become an important part of daily life. Mia always says that small steps matter more than big plans. They live in a mountainous region with few modern roads.
Nina thanked Mia for the honest advice. Nina will take part in a badminton match in February. On Sunday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. The garden is eight metres long.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. People around Nina often share different ideas about the living room. Nina prefers snowy weather when running in the museum. The baby drops the pacifier and laughs.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, the renovated train station now houses a bright public library.
Little by little, things began to change. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Mia advised Nina to try drawing as a new hobby.
